presentation.label: Complex oscillator
presentation.summary: Buchla-style FM complex oscillator: wavefolder, CAR/MOD morph, SYMM skew and modulator feedback on a mono FLEX track.
presentation.overview: CX OSC is a sixth machine-list row on FLEX tracks (Part signature CX,1). PLAYBACK sets pitch, ratio, index, fine tuning, fold amount and the folder input mix. SRC SETUP adds carrier and modulator morphs, index decay, fold symmetry, feedback and PWM skew. One CX OSC track per Part. Stock LFO page; no VOIC/CHRD. Declared conflict with FM Synth: do not install both.
highlights: Sixth machine-list row: CX OSC on FLEX, signature CX,1, mono render.
Sine wavefolder on PLAYBACK FOLD and MIX; CAR/MOD sine→saw→square morph on SRC SETUP.
DEC index envelope with HOLD at 127; SYMM bipolar fold skew; FDBK on SRC SETUP E.
FUNC snaps on PTCH and RATO; LFO PMTR lists CAR, MOD, SYMM, FDBK and PWM (30–34).
usage: Remove FM Synth from the module set if it is installed. Sync or trial CX OSC alone.
On a FLEX audio track: FUNC+SRC, or SELECT MACHINE TYPE, pick CX OSC (YES). Part signature reads CX.
PLAYBACK: PTCH, RATO, INDX, FINE, FOLD, MIX. SRC SETUP (FUNC+PLAYBACK): CAR, MOD, DEC, SYMM, FDBK, PWM.
Trig the track, tweak knobs, save the Part. Only one CX OSC track per Part is allowed.

access.location: FLEX audio track → FUNC+SRC or machine list → CX OSC.
steps: Remove FM Synth from the module set if it is installed.
FUNC+SRC on a FLEX track (or the machine list) → CX OSC → YES.
PLAYBACK and SRC SETUP pages as on octabam CX OSC; LFO page is stock.

controls.name: PTCH
controls.doc: PLAYBACK A: semitones, raw 64 = 0; FUNC snaps octave steps.

controls.name: RATO
controls.doc: PLAYBACK B: mod∶carrier ratio; FUNC snaps the classic table.

controls.name: FOLD
controls.doc: PLAYBACK E: wavefolder amount after the MIX point.

controls.name: MIX
controls.doc: PLAYBACK F: folder input crossfade carrier vs mod morph.

controls.name: FDBK
controls.doc: SRC SETUP E: modulator feedback (requires SETUP_ALL machine flag on Modwerk).

limitations: Cannot combine with FM Synth (synth): same Tim Hastie engine hook surface until base take hooks 63-84 ship and both packages migrate; owner group-owned relation required in compatibility.json at listing.
MIDI chromatic soak, power-cycle Keep after listing, and a listening sign-off remain open.

conditions.parameterModulation: LFO PMTR destinations include CAR/MOD/SYMM/FDBK/PWM; morph tables and wavefolder run per sample in sy_render. device:cx-stress sweeps hot PLAYBACK and SETUP bytes.
conditions.modeSwitching: FUNC+SRC assignment, double-tap PLAYBACK, Part switches during device:test; pattern mutated by device:cx-stress --arm-trigs.
conditions.maxLoad: One CX OSC track per Part (admission refused beyond three simultaneous morph stress instances on T1-T3). Stress presets morph_zero and morph_heavy with pattern trigs.
